## Definition

Adyen payment terminals are physical in-person devices that merchants inspect, power, network-connect, board and maintain before using an integrated or standalone payment flow. The V400m manual describes a Bluetooth base station that supplies Ethernet LAN access while the terminal is docked or undocked and charges it while docked. This hardware setup is separate from [[adyen-terminal-management]] fleet administration, [[adyen-terminal-api]] POS messaging, [[adyen-android-terminals]] on-terminal app deployment, and [[adyen-mobile-card-readers]] paired mobile reader operation.

## Operating boundary

The 2026-09-15 V400m manual requires shipment and device tamper checks with immediate Adyen Support contact if they fail. Its initial sequence boards the terminal over temporary Wi-Fi before first docking/pairing because the base obtains software from the terminal and can become stuck if connected too early. Diagnostic success checks platform/POS connectivity; it does not establish payment authorization or a particular device's current state. The manual's menu/software, cellular, battery and model details are a dated snapshot; confirm current model and account availability separately.
